title: OurHome Chore Points Leaderboard
dataSources: Baby feeds (`baby:feed`), baby sleep (`baby:sleep`), diaper changes (`diaper:change`), chore completions (`chore:completion`), allowance ledger (`allowance:ledger`), family calendar (`family:calendar`), growth measurements (`growth:measurement`), screen time (`screentime:usage`).
app: Baby-tracking app exports (Huckleberry/Baby Daybook), chore and allowance boards, shared family calendars, screen-time reports, and growth logs via Splunk HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ourhome:chore points=*
| stats sum(points) as total_value, avg(points) as avg_value by chore_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks chore values by total and average points across OurHome chore events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `points` values for each OurHome chore event and review total and average points by chore.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total points.
grandmaExplanation: It calmly which chore shows the biggest points numbers in your OurHome chore data.
